reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:3bdd1e5b84dbd2b1b59f721536ffe467]] I absolutely loved it.  It is super easy to use and looks like a natural eyelash.  In my photo, you can see the difference between my eyes with and without it.  I really recommend it!

They are very easy to use, you just have to outline your eyes and the lashes stick all day They are also very easy to remove, it doesn't hurt and The eyeliner is very easy to clean They can also be used multiple times and resave without problem

First of all, I have to say that these lashes are amazing!!! I'm someone who don't wear lashes because I'm afraid that they will be too long or unnatural. However, these lashes come in different sizes, in which I love, and they look amazing 😍. They are very easy to apply! If I can do it, any beginner can do it! I'm in love and I will definitely spread the word to my family and friends ❤

Loving the packaging! Feels luxurious and elegant. To be honest this is my first time trying magnetic eye lashes! Surprisingly it is really easy to apply and very convenient to stick it in place , since they are just clamps into place where you drew your eye liners !!!!!! The lashes have natural looks since not too much lashes . Definitely perfect for everyday use. Highly recommended!

The eyelashes are amazing! They look and feel so natural and beautiful. This box contains 5 pairs of eyelashes ,2 magnetic eyeliners ,as well as an eyelash applicator. This makes it super easy to apply the eyelashes. I usually have trouble with putting false eyelashes on, but this just makes everything so much easier. I love them and would recommend them to anyone looking for an easy way to spruce up your look!

reviews.t: Very nature styles, corners don’t stay on they come off
reviews.x: These are super easy to use and they are very natural style so if you like dramatic these are not for you. They do work however I must warn you just like some of the reviews I read that the corners do not stick as I find them coming off. I would invest my money and pay more for some that stick completely. I wouldn’t buy again becuz I want some that stick completely.
So far so good.  The first time was a little difficult.  The eye liner smells like metal at first.

I wore the smallest size in my look to go wedding dress shopping. They were super easy to put on. The liner was easy to use and precise. They also stayed on all day without any problem whatsoever. In fact, when I tried to remove them they were still so strongly attached I had to tug twice lol. The liner was a bit tough to remove but I feel that’s expected with magnetic liner. The only negative I have is that I didn’t trim these down because they didn’t look like I needed to but I feel like one s

I was very excited to see what all the hype was with magnetic lashes. Sadly, I am very disappointed in this product. Packaging was fine and the lashes look luminous. The liner/adhesive for the lashes to stay on is frustrating.  I have tried all the "pro" tips and still could not get these lashes to stay on completely. The inner corner of the lashes always comes up and ends up poking my eye lid or looking ridiculous because it takes the liner with it. I've tried adding more liner than what I thin
Absolute garbage. They do not set or stay on well at alllllllll.

I was pretty leery of this product. I previously had lash extensions and loved them it when Covid hit had to stop. I missed my extensions but not the price of upkeep. I saw these on sale and thought what the heck? They definitely exceeded my expectations. They were pretty easy to get on the first time. Now I know how to do it the second time should be even easier. I recommend having eye makeup remover and qtips handy to help with any stray liner. The lashes stuck wonderfully and actually were mo

reviews.t: An adjustment but worth the money
reviews.x: I really struggled with these lashes but I had to stop getting extensions so I really just forced myself to get comfortable with them. So I kind of played mad scientist and I'm gonna comfortable with them. I have some tips for anytime struggling.  1. If you HATE liquid eyeliner like me, do your eyeliner with whatever you use normally. I like my felt tip pens. So I did my eyeliner, then took the magnetic eyeliner, wiped the excess off the sides back into the tubs, and carefully just did a line th

reviews.t: Were did you get those Peepers?!
reviews.x: Like most women, I crave the long luscious lashes you see everywhere. I personally don't have the time or finances to keep up with lash extensions. Enter magnetic lashes!! I bought these thinking they couldn't possibly work. But WOW they work. I am not a girly girl and I could put them on! They were really easy to apply. The picture posted is far from glamorous, but it shows the amazing look of magnetic eyelashes. This was my very first attempt. They are reusable and you receive several pair. Th

So I was very skeptical about these. I struggle with putting on fake lashes, and magnetic lashes seemed too good to be true. I was also hesitant because I thought they would be heavy. Well, I can gladly report that I was wrong. The eyeliner is jet black, which I love. Glides on, easy to apply. The lashes really do just go on easily. Might take a little adjustment on the placement, but this is a great purchase.  I thought I would use them on special occasions, but I I was so impressed, that I use

reviews.t: I’m an amateur with lashes, but these were difficult.
reviews.x: I was so excited to get these on a deal. I should preface this by saying I don’t usually use liquid eyeliner, bc I’m not great at the application. I felt like this liner was really thin and difficult to apply. Once it’s applied, it’s a fairly easy process to apply the lashes. Either my eyelids are really small or these lashes are too long. When I apply the lashes, the don’t quite fit my lids and I’m not sure they can be trimmed down.

If I hadn't just taken them off, I'd take a photo. These are so much better than glue. With glue lashes, I would keep them on until bedtime simply because of all of the energy that went into applying them. Now, I come home get comfy, take off my lashes, change clothes, wash my face and relax. These are a wonderful option when you can't get to your lash specialist.

I don't wear makeup. I'm, in no way, capable of putting on fake eyelashes normally. I can't even do a straight line with eyeliner. I wear makeup like once a year, and you better believe it's a special occasion.  With these- you don't have to know what you are doing, or have any talent. It's so dang simple!! And fun. I am sold!

I only really like the 2 smaller sets.  The others look too crazy big on my tiny eyes.  They are hard to take off... I mean that in a good way.  Just make sure to shake the liner and give it a good couple min to dry.  I usually will do my eyebrows while the liner drys.  I wear contacts and have had zero issues with them.

They look nice but it’s not really magnetic it tells you to apply lashes while eyeliner is still wet. If it get the lashes perfectly in place the first time all power to you and they will look great and stick great ! But if you’re a beginner don’t by these and the brush is a bit difficult to take out of the bottle.

These were the first magnetic eyelashes that I have ever tried so I don't have anything to compare them to. For the price, they are woth it! The magnetic eyeliner that comes with it does seem to become less adhesive throughout the day while wearing it so I have had to reapply. They are easy to apply and look great!

Positive is that these are super easy to use and they look great. Negative is that they are just a tiny bit big for my eyes but I can’t trim them because of the magnet. I did trim off the tiny little ends past the magnet and that helps but makes them harder to get out of the case. I like them anyway.

Maybe because I’m a beginner, but these do not work. After a messy application, they only seem to stick for an hour or so and then start peeling at the corners. I also had to trim because they are super wide and wouldn’t fit my lash line. Also irritated my eyes ALOT!  Won’t be using anymore.

I so wanted to be able to love these, but I don't.. I applied the liner and have now waited 25 min and they are still so sticky.. So sticky that I can't apply the lashes yet. I have other sets and usually after a couple min they are dry and I can apply,thats not the case with these.. so sad

These look amazing! It did take me a few times to get it right but the results were worth it. I've never had false eyelashes before so I'm sure the struggle was because I'm new to it. I'd definitely recommend it. The eyeliner looks great and the lashes give mine a lot of volume

I have seen all the hype with the fake lashes. I was curious and leary about them. And picked these ones to try. This set is awesome. Super easy to apply and take off. And they look really good. Super happy with this purchase. And Defaintly will be buying more of these.

claims.text: Most reviewers find the lashes easy to apply and use, especially with the magnetic eyeliner.
Many reviewers praise the natural, beautiful look of the lashes.
Several reviewers report that the lashes or corners do not stay on well.
Some reviewers note a learning curve or difficulty, particularly with the eyeliner application.
A few reviewers mention the eyeliner has an unpleasant smell or is thin and hard to apply.
